title: Booking & Payment
outcome: A customer can create exactly one booking from a valid quote and active inventory hold, then initiate and reconcile an approved provider-hosted payment without duplicate financial effects.
actor: Authenticated customer, with verified payment webhooks from the approved provider.
modules: Booking owns the immutable commercial snapshot and booking lifecycle.
Payments owns provider attempts, webhook verification, reconciliation and payment lifecycle.
Inventory remains authoritative for the active hold; VS-09 may consume but must not bypass it.
Pricing remains authoritative for the quote snapshot used to create the booking.
routes: Landing / Discovery -> Package Details -> Plan -> Active Inventory Hold
Booking payment state -> VS-10 confirmation entry
acceptance: A valid customer-owned quote and active hold create one immutable booking with a human-readable reference.
The booking snapshots departure, travellers, occupancy, currency, total, due-now, instalment schedule and price version without recomputing money.
Repeating the same create-booking request returns the original booking and never creates a duplicate.
A reused idempotency key with a different request is rejected deterministically.
Expired, released, foreign or already-consumed holds cannot create a booking.
Payment initiation uses provider-hosted or tokenised payment handling; NoorPath never receives raw card data.
Provider callbacks are authenticated, replay-safe and mapped to explicit pending, succeeded, failed or requires-action states.
Duplicate or out-of-order webhooks do not create duplicate financial effects or regress a terminal state.
The customer sees clear non-scarcity messaging for payment pending, failed, cancelled and retry-safe states.
Telemetry links booking reference, payment attempt, provider event, correlation ID and outcome without leaking sensitive payment data.
exclusions: Final booking confirmation and durable inventory commitment; owned by VS-10.
Refunds, chargebacks, disputes and operator-led payment corrections.
Multiple payment providers, saved cards, wallet balances or offline cash collection.
Multi-room bookings, child or infant pricing, promotions and dynamic pricing.
Raw card number, CVV or unrestricted provider payload storage.
